metrics.reason: Chapman point estimate only; not a guarantee or a confidence interval.

warning: Exploratory two-list capture–recapture, not an assurance of completeness. Requires a closed unchanged issue population, independent inspections, roughly equal detectability, correct identity links and no duplicates within either list. Holds change the analyzed population. Positive dependence can underestimate unseen issues; heterogeneous detection and mistaken links can bias either direction. Similar text is not proof of the same physical issue. Never automatically close, merge or send issues.
